correctness.rationale: Derivations preserve the one-dimensional derived ideal; a rank-one derivation with nonzero action there would force a zero V-block and contradict nondegeneracy. With D(z)=0, central maps are all nonzero V-linear functionals into the center. In the noncentral rank-one case write D(v)=psi(v)(u+cz); the derivation equation forces B(u,-), B(-,u) to vanish on ker psi, hence they are opposite scalar multiples of psi and u lies in the symmetrization radical. This gives both necessity and sufficiency of the line/t/s normal form. Its square is tB(u,u)D. Over finite characteristic two the square-root of Q=B(u,u) restricted to W is a linear functional; its nonzero fibers yield q^(r-1) anisotropic lines and hence q^r maps of every nonzero eigenvalue. Direct enumerative checks of 11 concrete finite algebras over F2, F3, F4 from actual verify.py returned VERIFY_OK; universality follows from proof rather than checks. Limits: nondegenerate B and rank one.

originality.rationale: Mancini–La Rosa arXiv:2106.12904 (2021) classifies the bilinear-form algebra structures and is not a derivation rank-stratification. La Rosa–Mancini arXiv:2301.11058 (2023) supplies derivation matrices for distinguished canonical classes, generally assuming characteristic different from two: individual odd-characteristic rank-one cases can be inferred there, and are not claimed new. The complete all-form rank-one parametrization and characteristic-two diagonal criterion with uniform fiber multiplicity q^r is not implied by the examined literature. Published mathematical-record searches on derivation rank one, characteristic two and bilinear form identified distinct objects/results. Residual possibility: equivalent results in finite-field infinitesimal isometry or Leibniz operator literature, especially unpublished or unindexed; this is a bounded originality assessment, not uniqueness proof.
residual_risks: Full theorem may have an equivalent formulation within broader bilinear-form isometry or Leibniz derivation literature not indexed by queries.

The 2023 comprehensive derivation-matrix work includes some odd-characteristic instances as corollaries; only the all-characteristic uniform stratum and sharp even-characteristic counting distinction are claimed as the additional contribution.

value.rationale: Rank-one derivations are the first nontrivial stratum of a natural derivation algebra; they control minimal-dimensional infinitesimal actions and square-zero versus idempotent directions. The result completely classifies this stratum for all nondegenerate bilinear-form Leibniz algebras, not arbitrary parameter examples. The formula q^n-1+q(q^r-1) and sharp characteristic-two criterion distinguish forms with the same symmetrization-radical dimension but different diagonal restrictions, e.g. identity versus alternating 2x2 forms; q^r idempotents is a uniform non-obvious exact invariant. It is beyond mere rephrasing of the known canonical matrices, though higher-rank derivations remain outside the scope.
